about: Modwerk source-only ctrl-in-perf package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/ctrl-in-perf.

mods.title: Ctrl In Perf
mods.summary: EXP/CV IN 1 or 2 plays a performance macro: a PERF DEST row in the CONTROL INPUT menus sends the jack to PF1 to PF12.
mods.description: Ctrl In Perf adds PERF DEST to GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and 2 in CV and EXPR modes. Set it to PF1 to PF12 and the jack sets that performance macro as its knob would: CV ZERO LEVEL to CV MAX LEVEL, or the learned EXPR range, maps to 0 to 127, the macro's performance locks follow and its pad lights in PERF mode. The jack always wins: while it drives a macro, that macro's knob and pad are overwritten at the next audio block. The value moves in whole steps and holds still against converter noise. Nothing is sent over MIDI or Overbridge, and the kit is not marked edited. PERF DEST is saved with the globals slot. It is a port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0017-ctrl-in-perf to OS 1.74.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: Ran on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 (T208, 2026-11-08), alone on the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 with a remote-key layer, built from this source as 1.0.0-experimental: PERF DEST shows and steps in CV mode, MODE OFF hides it, and PF1 was kept over a project save, reload and power cycle. On 2026-11-09 (T221, the same package on the Modwerk base plain variant 1c14b6b0) an Analog Four's CV OUT A into EXP/CV IN 1 at 0, 2.5 and 5 V set macro 1 to 0, 64 and 127, and a BD TUNE lock on performance 1 followed. EXPR mode and CONTROL INPUT 2 have not run on a unit.
